description: ATAP v0.1 §9.4(2) acceptance evidence: each case is a Witness Event whose payload smuggles a person-resolvable field forbidden by ATAP §7.6 (a person's name, email or phone number), free text (a sentence as a tool name, a raw prompt, model output or decision subject where only a sha256 is allowed), or an extra key carrying either. Every case MUST FAIL validation against witness-events.schema.json — every payload is additionalProperties:false, identifiers match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,63}$ (no spaces, no @, no +), digests are 64-hex sha256 and human_decision.role is a closed enum, so there is no permitted place for PII. Each case is otherwise valid, so it fails only for the PII. CI asserts each case is rejected; a case that validates is a profile defect.

must_reject.reason: email address in place of an agent id (ATAP §7.6)
